mapper.select: select t.city as city, count(*) as trip_count, coalesce(sum(t.days), 0) as day_count, coalesce(sum(ex.amt), 0) as total_amount, coalesce(sum(it.cnt), 0) as item_count from trips t left join (select trip_id, sum(amount) as amt from trip_expenses group by trip_id) ex on ex.trip_id = t.id left join (select trip_id, count(*) as cnt from trip_items where day_index >= 1 group by trip_id) it on it.trip_id = t.id where t.username = #{username} group by t.city order by total_amount desc, t.city

select t.city as city, e.category as category, sum(e.amount) as amount, count(distinct t.id) as trip_count from trips t join trip_expenses e on e.trip_id = t.id where t.username = #{username} group by t.city, e.category order by amount desc
